rv.q: Rice's company conveys messages of love, loyalty and forgiveness that are very grown-up – and resonate strongly today in a five-star show that goes right to the heart.
It’s simply impossible not to have fun, with the audience gleefully whooping and applauding the performers and the band before the play even properly started.
Soul-stirring revival of the Kneehigh favourite
An iconic production finally back on the road, Tristan & Yseult remains essential viewing.
It is a still marvel of theatrical innovation, a blueprint for dealing with an old story in a new way, bringing bathos to romance but without undercutting its power.
It is a genre-bending masterpiece, examining the hefty topic of love with remarkable playfulness.

cn.t: Critics hail Emma Rice's revival as a genre-bending masterpiece, with one calling it their favorite production ever. The 20-year-old show still dazzles with its irresistible blend of circus, cabaret, comedy, and tragedy.
